header.title: AI oversight
header.description: Human oversight of automated AI decisions (EU AI Act art. 14). Automated rejections are queued here as proposals — you decide.

queue.title: Decision queue
queue.emptyPending: No pending AI proposals — all automated decisions have been reviewed.

toasts.approvedDescription: The action was executed and recorded in the audit log.
toasts.approvedNotExecuted: Proposal approved, but the action could not be executed (target no longer exists).
toasts.rejectedDescription: The automated action was blocked and recorded in the audit log.
toasts.alreadyDecided: This proposal has already been decided by someone else.
toasts.forbidden: Only recruiters and admins can decide on AI proposals.

retention.title: AI logging & retention
retention.description: Every AI decision is logged in an append-only register (WORM). The EU AI Act requires a minimum retention of {{months}} months.
retention.wormProtected: Append-only (WORM) — logs cannot be modified or deleted

candidateSummary.title: AI usage for this candidate
candidateSummary.hint: Transparency overview (EU AI Act art. 13): which AI processing has been applied to this candidate. Categories, dates and models only — never content.
candidateSummary.empty: No AI has been applied to this candidate.
candidateSummary.disclosure: The recruiter retains the final judgement on every AI-assisted decision.
